title: Team member
description: One person on the TDM team. Collected at first-run setup and stored in the data store (Team tab), never inside the plugin. Roles drive who may approve which gate.

handle.description: Short kebab-case id used in job records, e.g. samarth, ravi-editor.

role.description: admin approves admin gates and budget overruns; editor and designer approve editor gates on jobs assigned to them.

email.description: Used to share the TDM Studio Drive folder and to identify the person. Never put in evals or examples.
